name: lender-report
title: Monthly report to the lender
for_each: select id, code || ' ' || name as label from projects where lender is not null and stage not in ('settled', 'abandoned') order by code

sections.title: The project
sections.sql: select p.name as project, p.address, p.lender, dollars(p.facility_limit) as facility, p.facility_expires_on as facility_expires, p.stage, p.construction_start_on as construction_started, p.completion_forecast_on as completion_forecast from projects p where p.id = $1

sections.title: Feasibility and forecast
sections.sql: select feaso_version as approved_version, dollars(feaso_revenue) as approved_revenue, dollars(feaso_cost) as approved_cost, feaso_margin_pct || '%' as approved_margin_on_cost, dollars(forecast_revenue) as forecast_revenue, dollars(forecast_cost) as forecast_cost, forecast_margin_pct || '%' as forecast_margin_on_cost from project_position where project_id = $1

sections.title: Cost report
sections.sql: select code, description, dollars(budget) as budget, dollars(committed) as committed, dollars(actual) as spent, dollars(forecast_final) as forecast, dollars(cost_to_complete) as to_complete from cost_position where project_id = $1 order by code

sections.title: Presales
sections.sql: select sold as lots_sold, unsold as lots_unsold, dollars(exchanged_value) as exchanged, dollars(qualifying_value) as qualifying_presales, dollars(hurdle) as covenant_hurdle, case when qualifying_value >= hurdle then 'met' else 'short by ' || dollars(hurdle - qualifying_value) end as covenant from presale_position where project_id = $1

sections.title: Drawdowns
sections.sql: select number, period_to, status, dollars(amount) as amount, qs_certified_on, funded_on from drawdowns where project_id = $1 order by number

sections.title: Conditions still open
sections.sql: select a.reference as consent, c.number, c.gate as must_be_met, c.description from conditions c join approvals a on a.id = c.approval_id where a.project_id = $1 and c.status = 'open' order by c.gate, c.number

name: feasibility-summary
title: Feasibility summary
for_each: select f.id, p.code || ' v' || f.version || ' ' || f.label as label from feasibilities f join projects p on p.id = f.project_id where f.status in ('approved', 'draft') order by p.code, f.version

sections.title: Summary
sections.sql: select project, version, label, status, prepared_on, dollars(revenue) as revenue, dollars(cost) as cost, dollars(profit) as profit, margin_on_cost_pct || '%' as margin_on_cost, target_margin_pct || '%' as target_margin from feasibility_totals where feasibility_id = $1

sections.title: Revenue and costs
sections.sql: select side, category, description, dollars(amount) as amount, start_month as from_month, span_months as months from feasibility_lines where feasibility_id = $1 order by side desc, start_month, description

name: buyer-update
title: Construction update for your home
for_each: select l.id, p.code || ' lot ' || l.lot_no || ' ' || coalesce(l.buyer, '') as label from lots l join projects p on p.id = l.project_id where l.status = 'exchanged' order by p.code, l.lot_no

sections.title: Your purchase
sections.sql: select l.buyer, p.name as development, p.address, l.lot_no as lot, l.kind, l.bedrooms, l.exchanged_on as contract_date, l.deposit_held_by from lots l join projects p on p.id = l.project_id where l.id = $1

sections.title: Where the build is
sections.note: Dates are forecasts and can move. We will write again when anything changes.
sections.sql: select p.stage, p.construction_start_on as construction_started, p.completion_forecast_on as completion_expected from lots l join projects p on p.id = l.project_id where l.id = $1
